tools.description: The agent's MCData state: whether it can send, its MCData ID, its functional alias, unread messages.
tools.name: status

tools.description: Send a one-to-one MCData short data message (SDS) to an MCData user, as the agent's functional alias. Returns the message ID and, depending on 'wait', the network's answer and the recipient's reports.

report.description: which disposition notifications to ask the recipient for

text.description: the message; line breaks are kept

timeout_s.description: how long to wait, in seconds (1 to 300, default 30)

to.description: the recipient's MCData ID, a SIP URI (sip:user@domain)

wait.description: return once the message is sent (the network accepted it), delivered or read; none returns at once

tools.name: send_message

tools.description: Reply to a received message, in its conversation (InReplyTo), as the agent's functional alias.

message_id.description: the ID of the received message

report.description: which disposition notifications to ask the recipient for

text.description: the reply; line breaks are kept

timeout_s.description: how long to wait, in seconds (1 to 300, default 30)

wait.description: return once the reply is sent, delivered or read; none returns at once

tools.name: reply_message

tools.description: What is known of a sent or received message or file: network answer, delivered, read, file state.
tools.name: message_status

tools.description: Received one-to-one messages and file offers, oldest first. Without 'since', the latest ones; with it, those after that sequence number (pass the last_seq of the previous call to read on).

limit.description: at most this many items (1 to 200)

since.description: only items with a higher seq

tools.name: inbox

tools.description: Wait for the next received one-to-one message or file offer and return it; returns timed_out when none comes. Without 'since', only what arrives after the call.

since.description: return the first item with a higher seq, even one already received

timeout_s.description: how long to wait, in seconds (1 to 300, default 60)

tools.name: wait_message

tools.description: Mark a received message read. Sends the read report when the sender asked for one; reading the inbox never does.
tools.name: mark_read

tools.description: Send a file from the agent's outbox directory to an MCData user (file distribution over HTTP), as the agent's functional alias. Returns once the file is uploaded and offered.

file.description: the file's name in the outbox directory

mandatory.description: the recipient downloads it without asking its user

timeout_s.description: how long to wait, in seconds (1 to 300, default 60)

to.description: the recipient's MCData ID, a SIP URI

tools.name: send_file

tools.description: Accept (download), reject or defer a received file offer. Accept returns the downloaded file's path.

timeout_s.description: how long to wait, in seconds (1 to 300, default 120)

tools.name: respond_file
